marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to west 20 knots late overnight and to
west 25 early Friday morning. Wind diminishing to west 15 early Friday evening
and to light late Friday evening. Snow changing to scattered flurries near noon Friday.
Blowing snow Friday afternoon. Visibility 1 mile or less in snow and as low as 1
mile in blowing snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 late
Friday morning then subsiding to 1 or less Friday evening.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Saturday: Wind light increasing to southeast 20 knots
 in the morning.<br/>Sunday: Wind southeast 20 knots increasing to west 25
 late in the day.<br/>Monday: Wind southwest 20 knots veering to northwest 15
 late in the day.<br/>
